title: Harvest and Cellar
author: Coral Joubert
blurb: Rafael Lockridge, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, has spent five years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must get the family out ahead of the count before the well refills.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
